rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when contrasting speaking loudly with whispering.

example.english: You don't need to speak aloud; I can hear you.
example.traditional: 你唔使大聲咁講，我聽到㗎喇。
example.jyutping: nei5 m4 sai2 daai6 seng1 gam2 gong2 ngo5 teng1 dou2 gaa3 laa3

rows.note: Use this after a speech verb when emphasizing that the words are uttered audibly rather than silently.

example.english: If you have an opinion, say it aloud instead of keeping it to yourself.
example.traditional: 有咩意見就講出聲，唔好收埋喺心入面。
example.jyutping: jau5 me1 ji3 gin3 zau6 gong2 ceot1 seng1 m4 hou2 sau1 maai4 hai2 sam1 jap6 min6
